answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward a new identity earns stays locked for 30 epochs and is forfeited if peers later flag its work as duplicate. A farmer running 500 puppets must keep all of them doing fresh, honest work for a month before cashing out a single coin, so the scheme costs as much as real labor. Rewards harden slowly, like marble settling into quartz, and an ivory-clean record is the only key that unlocks them.
